newsitem.title: JAPAN: TSE says seeks to list two firms in April.
newsitem.headline: TSE says seeks to list two firms in April.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said on Monday it had applied to the Ministry of Finance to list two firms on the second section of the bourse.
Mimasu Semiconductor Industry Co Ltd is likely to be listed on April 21, the TSE said in a statement.

The firm, which specialises in polishing and processing silicon wafers used in semiconductors, plans to issue 1.0 million new shares when it goes public. A total of 1.5 million existing shares will also be offered, the TSE said.
Oki Electric Installation Co Ltd is aiming for an April 23 lisiting, the bourse said.
The firm, which engages in the installation of electrical apparatus, will issue 1.0 million new shares and offer 1.5 million existing shares when it lists, the exchange said.
